# Parpar — B2B Pest Control Supplier in Egypt
> https://parpareg.com

## About
Parpar is a B2B supplier and manufacturer of premium pest control products in Egypt. We supply cockroach killer sprays, mosquito repellent sprays, electric vaporizer liquids, and complete heating device kits to hotels, cleaning companies, distributors, and bulk buyers across Egypt and the Middle East.

## Key Facts
- Location: Cairo, Egypt
- Market: B2B wholesale pest control products
- Certifications: Egyptian Pesticide Production License, MSDS, GHS Safety Data Sheet, Dermal Toxicity Test, Independent Lab Test Report
- Distribution: 50+ partners across 20+ Egyptian governorates
- Response time: Within 24 hours

## Products
### Cockroach Killer Spray (Red & Gold)
- Form: Aerosol Spray, 45ml
- Target: Cockroaches, German Cockroaches, American Cockroaches
- Packaging: 96 pcs/ctn, Aerosol Can + Color Box
- Shelf life: 5 years

### Mosquito Repellent Spray (Blue)
- Form: Aerosol Spray, 45ml
- Target: Mosquitoes (Aedes, Anopheles, Culex)
- Packaging: 96 pcs/ctn, Aerosol Can + Color Box
- Shelf life: 5 years

### Mosquito Repellent Liquid (Bottle Refill)
- Form: Liquid Refill, 45ml
- Ingredient: Citrine Oil 0.8%, D110 99.2%
- Packaging: 200 pcs/ctn, Liquid Bottle + Color Box
- Shelf life: 5 years

### Mosquito Liquid Large Heater (Desktop)
- Form: Electric Vaporizer Kit, 220V~50Hz 5W
- Coverage: up to 30m²
- Packaging: Heater + Liquid Kit + Color Box, 100 pcs/ctn
- Best for: Hotels, living rooms, offices

### Mosquito Liquid Spherical Heater
- Form: Spherical Vaporizer Kit, 220V~50Hz 5W
- Packaging: 120 pcs/ctn
- Best for: Bedrooms, small offices
